meta.title: DSH Memories
meta.description: Personal memory for DSH: every new session starts with a memory guide that drives the agent to capture memories itself, unprompted — user corrections and preferences, repeated topics and decisions, wrap-up durable facts — routed to the right scope (project-specific → workspace, cross-project → long) and de-duplicated against the injected index; a global long-term index, a global short-term note, and a workspace memory index are each injected whole, composed fresh in memory at session start from memory files carrying a one-line Description — no index file is read or written; the /memory command and the agent memory tool write and preview memories; the Memories right-sidebar tab lists all memories and shows each one's full content on a detail page, scoped to the current session's workspace.
